description: This file defines functions and constants for accessing embedded resource forks in the FreeType project, including guessing resource locations and retrieving header and data offsets.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Guess
methods.description: Guesses the file name and offset where the resource fork is stored, using multiple rules.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_HeaderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves header information from a resource fork, including map and data offsets.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_DataOffsets
methods.description: Gets data offsets for a specific resource tag within a resource fork.
